phase_1.title: Phase 1 · M60E4 / Mk 43 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×51mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 415 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 415 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 439 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 820 m/s (3190 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 100-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the M60E4 / Mk 43 staged for its 500–650 RPM steady cadence (controllable bursts) cadence.

zh.headline: 美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪：1957 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 绰号「野猪」（The Pig）的 M60 于 1957 年融合了德国 FG 42 直线回转枪机与 MG 42 顶盖供弹理念；经海军特战司令部深度改进的 M60E4（Mk 43）攻克了早期枪管更换烫手与闭锁滚轮磨损痛点，以沉稳的 550 发/分射速与前小握把赢得海豹突击队青睐。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M60E4 / Mk 43 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1957 年问世的 美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪 由美国萨科防务 / 美国军械公司（Saco Defense / U.S. Ordnance）主导研制，定位为经典的通用机枪。M60 成为越战时期最具视觉符号意义的班组机枪，而现代升级版 M60E4/E6 更在 2014 年击败多款新锐机枪中标丹麦国防军新一代轻量化通用机枪。
绰号「野猪」（The Pig）的 M60 于 1957 年融合了德国 FG 42 直线回转枪机与 MG 42 顶盖供弹理念；经海军特战司令部深度改进的 M60E4（Mk 43）攻克了早期枪管更换烫手与闭锁滚轮磨损痛点，以沉稳的 550 发/分射速与前小握把赢得海豹突击队青睐。 整件装备总长 958 mm（E4 特战短管构型）、空重 9.89 kg，成为同期通用机枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1957 年，美国萨科防务 / 美国军械公司（Saco Defense / U.S. Ordnance）推出了划时代的美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪。M60 成为越战时期最具视觉符号意义的班组机枪，而现代升级版 M60E4/E6 更在 2014 年击败多款新锐机枪中标丹麦国防军新一代轻量化通用机枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于直线无托式后坐布局使复进簧直伸枪托抵肩处，550 发/分慢节奏便于徒手点射，奠定了其在通用机枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪 的机械灵魂在于其「白膨胀室自调短行程导气活塞 · FG 42 系双突笋回转开膛枪机」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。M60E4 回归单手可换带提把司太立衬膛枪管，告别早期「石棉手套换管」痛点，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪 采用白膨胀室自调短行程导气活塞 · FG 42 系双突笋回转开膛枪机。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了M60E4 回归单手可换带提把司太立衬膛枪管，告别早期「石棉手套换管」痛点。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×51mm NATO 弹药规格与 439 mm 司太立合金衬膛快换重枪管（4 条右旋 · 305 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 415 MPa，可赋予弹头 820 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,190 J 动能，有效作用距离达 1100 米。
内膛技术特点方面，弹膛至枪管前段镶嵌钴铬钨司太立（Stellite）高温耐磨内衬延长连发寿命。同时，改良单向防装反导气活塞与强化顶盖拨弹轮可在盖板闭合状态直接上链，令其在 500–650 发/分（低沉可控节奏 · 单发点控） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 439 毫米身管与 7.62×51mm NATO 口径，美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪 实现了每秒 820 米的初速与 1100 米有效射程。弹膛至枪管前段镶嵌钴铬钨司太立（Stellite）高温耐磨内衬延长连发寿命，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 100 发容量的弹链受弹盘与挂弹箱体与 47 mm 膛轴设计，美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 10.6 N·s 水平。前护木集成垂直握把与轻型两脚架，兼顾行进间腰射压制与阵地架射。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-52）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 100 发容量的弹链受弹盘与挂弹箱体与出色的整体工效，前护木集成垂直握把与轻型两脚架，兼顾行进间腰射压制与阵地架射。欢迎在 BAY-52 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 美国 M60E4（Mk 43）通用机枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M60E4 / Mk 43
paragraphs: Introduced in 1957 by Saco Defense / U.S. Ordnance in United States, the Saco Defense M60E4 (Mk 43) emerged as a defining General-Purpose Machine Gun. An unmistakable icon of the Vietnam era, the thoroughly modernized M60E4/E6 lineage even won Denmark’s 2014 lightweight GPMG competition against much newer rivals.

Born in 1957 from FG 42 inline rotating-bolt and MG 42 feed-tray concepts, the M60 matured into the Navy SEAL-requested M60E4 (Mk 43)—curing early barrel-change issues while preserving its uniquely controllable 550 RPM cadence. Measuring 958 mm (E4 / Mk 43 Compact Commando Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 9.89 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Machine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1957, Saco Defense / U.S. Ordnance of United States introduced the Saco Defense M60E4 (Mk 43). An unmistakable icon of the Vietnam era, the thoroughly modernized M60E4/E6 lineage even won Denmark’s 2014 lightweight GPMG competition against much newer rivals. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Inline stock recoil system and steady 550 RPM rate allow controllable shoulder-fired bursts — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Saco Defense M60E4 (Mk 43) sits its Self-Regulating Short-Stroke Gas Piston · FG 42-Derived Rotating Open Bolt & M13 Belt Feed. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 415 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, E4 integrates a barrel-mounted carry handle and Stellite liner, ending asbestos-glove swaps, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Saco Defense M60E4 (Mk 43) relies on Self-Regulating Short-Stroke Gas Piston · FG 42-Derived Rotating Open Bolt & M13 Belt Feed. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: E4 integrates a barrel-mounted carry handle and Stellite liner, ending asbestos-glove swaps.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×51mm NATO with 439 mm Stellite-Lined Quick-Change Barrel (4-Groove RH · 1:12" Twist), the Saco Defense M60E4 (Mk 43) develops 820 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,190 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 1100 meters.

Internally, Cobalt-chromium Stellite bore liner resists throat erosion during sustained automatic fire. Combined with its 500–650 RPM steady cadence (controllable bursts) tempo, Reversible-proof gas piston and upgraded feed cam allow belt loading with the top cover closed, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×51mm NATO through its 439 millimeter bore, the Saco Defense M60E4 (Mk 43) achieves 820 meters per second and 1100 meters of effective reach. Cobalt-chromium Stellite bore liner resists throat erosion during sustained automatic fire.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 100-round ammunition belt feed tray & box with a 47 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 10.6 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Forward vertical grip and receiver-mounted bipod balance assault mobility with bipod stability.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-52), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
